title: Leader answer — done-gate (stage 3, scope §2.5, E18, E19)
description: The stage-2 done-gate answer with `included_fixes` and the wider `discoveries`. approve needs no unmet AC, no include discovery, no out-of-scope fix, and at most FOLLOWUPS_MAX followups. A `manual` verdict carries `why_not_automated` (E5). ENUM TEMPLATE: values like "{answers}" are placeholders that schema.fill_enums replaces for each call (codes.LEADER_SCHEMA_TOKENS); an enum that comes out empty drops the nearest array or nullable property (read as [] / null). Keeps to type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum (the CLI's structured-output subset). Rules a schema cannot say are checked by gxengine/leader.py (codes.LeaderFormatReason).

answer.description: One of the answers the engine allows for this call (rendered per call). The engine acts on this field only.

reason.description: Leader-decision reason code (§4.2, scope D20). Pick `other` only when no code fits.

step.description: The step to run again — set exactly when answer is rerun, otherwise null.

note.description: Free text for the next role (leader-decision.md), the human and evolve. The engine never branches on it.

recommendation.description: Set exactly when answer is escalate: what you recommend the human answers (scope D15). Otherwise null.

step.description: Set exactly when the recommended answer is rerun.

ac_verdicts.description: One entry per AC id, each exactly once.

evidence.description: Where the evidence is (test, file, run). Shown in the PR body.

why_not_automated.description: Set (not blank) exactly when status is manual, otherwise null (E5): why no automated check proves this criterion; when the design documents proposed one (a test, a guard), why that proposal was not taken. Shown in the PR body.

title.description: Title of the follow-up Issue — set exactly when disposition is followup.

duplicate_of.description: The candidate Issue this duplicates — set exactly when disposition is duplicate.

discoveries.description: One entry per collected out-of-scope discovery D1..Dn, each exactly once (E19).

included_fixes.description: One entry per out-of-scope fix F1..Fn the engine included because it blocked an AC (E18), each exactly once. approve needs every one keep.

summary.description: What this change does to the code, from the diff: one to three lines, one sentence each, no verdict. The first thing a reviewer reads at the top of the pull request body (stage 4). approve needs one to three; any answer at most three, none blank.
